record_rule: every decision whose menu has >= 2 states yields a record: menu binding, state-index binding and page sources exactly as the model saw them, the teacher label and whether the adapter agreed
stop_rule: run complete episodes in walk order until the cell holds >= 1024 records (first 32 per episode); build-corpus takes the first 1024 in walk/episode order (the last episode may contribute partially); if the walk is exhausted first, use every record if >= 512, otherwise blocked exit
sample_order: samples = [(record_id, copy) for record_id in on_policy_ids + replay_ids for copy in (0, 1)], then random.Random(f'order:dagger:{algorithm}:{seed}').shuffle(samples), then sequential
